name: primitives-headless-tabs
title: Headless Switch
blurb: Animated tab switcher with composable thumb and icon components.
description: Tab switcher primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion. Features composable SwitchThumb and SwitchIcon components for tab animation.
use_when: Building animated tab interfaces with smooth transitions between content sections.
avoid_when: When you need a simple tab switcher without animation or custom composition.
a11y: Built on Headless UI primitives with full keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
